title: Efficient Adaptive Data Analysis over Dense Data Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2602.07732v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern data workflows are inherently adaptive, repeatedly querying the same dataset to refine and validate sequential decisions, but such adaptivity can lead to overfitting and invalid statistical inference. Adaptive Data Analysis (ADA) mechanisms address this challenge; however, there is a fundamental tension between computational efficiency and sample complexity. For $T$ rounds of adaptive analysis, computationally efficient algorithms typically incur suboptimal $O(\sqrt{T})$ sample complexity, whereas for arbitrary distributions, algorithms with $O(\log T)$ sample complexity are computationally intractable under standard cryptographic assumptions. In this work, we shed light on this trade-off by identifying a natural class of data distributions under which both computational efficiency and logarithmic sample complexity in $T$ are achievable. translated_title: 密集数据分布上的高效自适应数据分析
translated_abstract: 现代数据工作流本质上是自适应的，它们反复查询同一数据集以优化和验证一系列决策，但这种自适应性可能导致过拟合和无效的统计推断。自适应数据分析（ADA）机制旨在解决这一挑战；然而，计算效率与样本复杂度之间存在根本性的矛盾。对于T轮自适应分析，计算高效的算法通常只能达到次优的O(√T)样本复杂度，而在标准密码学假设下，对于任意分布，具有O(log T)样本复杂度的算法在计算上是难以实现的。在本工作中，我们通过识别一类自然的数据分布来阐明这一权衡关系，证明在这类分布下可以同时实现计算效率和对数级O(log T)的样本复杂度。我们提出了一种计算高效的ADA机制，该机制实现了O(log T)的样本复杂度。
tldr: 该论文识别出一类自然的密集数据分布，并提出了一种计算高效的自适应数据分析机制，在此类分布上同时实现了对数级O(log T)样本复杂度，从而化解了计算效率与样本复杂度之间的根本性权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a natural class of dense data distributions under which a computationally efficient Adaptive Data Analysis mechanism achieves logarithmic O(log T) sample complexity, resolving the fundamental trade-off between computational efficiency and sample complexity.
